name: Stoner-Wohlfarth particle

slots.Xi: magnetization angle, measured from the hard axis: angles on (S^1)^1, period 6.283
slots.C: single domain (exchange keeps the magnetization uniform); overdamped Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert relaxation in the plane that contains the easy axis and the field; thermal bath
slots.R: magnetization along the easy axis, sin(phi) (magnetometry or the magneto-optical Kerr effect)
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of h
slots.A: h=0.5, psi=1.5708; control h in (0.0, 1.5); noise D=0.05

provenance: E. C. Stoner and E. P. Wohlfarth, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 240, 599 (1948)

events.kind: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

required: No obstruction: along the critical direction the target realizes the pitchfork generator eps s - |a3| s^3 + h, with eps proportional to the distance of the control from its critical value.

events.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

required: A quadratic term makes the write one-sided (a threshold): the material must supply the mirror term -a2 s^2, from a symmetric partner of the critical mode or a second parameter tuned to the cusp.
Changing the control also pushes the critical mode, so a sweep writes a fixed state: the protocol must add the opposite field, or the material must be symmetric under reversal of the mode.

barrier.method: The straight path between the two states was relaxed as a nudged elastic band of 24 images (descent along the force on the band, then damped dynamics with a climbing image, until the largest force on an image is below 1e-05). The highest image of the band is a saddle with one unstable direction.

threshold_source: field at which the write-field continuation loses the stored state

verdict.writes: supercritical pitchfork at h = 1; a uniform field removes the stable state at h = 0.185
verdict.lock: field 0.4 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.50, not rewritten; field 1.5 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.93, retention/rewriting time ratio 0.8; field 0.4 x threshold, control swept through the write point: accuracy 0.73, not rewritten
